title: Add built‑in request body parser (JSON & URL‑encoded)
description: Many applications need to read request bodies, but yantraverse currently only exposes raw streams. This feature introduces a lightweight, zero‑dependency parser that automatically populates ctx.body for JSON and URL‑encoded payloads, with configurable size limits and error handling. It reduces boilerplate and aligns yantraverse with other production‑grade frameworks.
testCases: Parse a valid JSON payload and verify ctx.body contains the expected object
Parse a valid URL‑encoded payload and verify ctx.body contains the expected key/value pairs
Reject payloads exceeding the configured size limit with a 413 response
acceptance: The middleware correctly parses JSON and URL‑encoded bodies up to the default 1 MB limit, populates ctx.body, returns appropriate HTTP error codes for oversized or unsupported content types, and integrates seamlessly with existing routing and error handling without breaking current tests.
reason: Body parsing is a core requirement for APIs; providing it out‑of‑the‑box eliminates the need for external packages, keeps the framework zero‑dependency, and improves developer productivity and security by enforcing size limits and content‑type validation.
